cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.

mechanism: A assumes the power to certify success and interprets a visibly failed outcome as evidence the official process met its checks.
confusable: D164 finds a useful side benefit; D185 must specifically declare process compliance proves system success despite the failed outcome.
comparison: Cake failure is certified quality control and customer agreement; trapped drill participants are certified assembly and headcount compliance.
seedUse: Both cards and all four seeds read. Preserve the actual failed outcome and exact compliance checks; do not treat A success verdict as an objective validation.
